Yes, **Dell Technologies** sells servers equipped with **NVIDIA A40 GPUs** as part of their **PowerEdge** and **DSS (Dell Storage Server)** product lines. The **NVIDIA A40** is a high-performance **data center GPU** designed for AI, deep learning, HPC, and graphics workloads.

### **Dell Servers Supporting NVIDIA A40 GPUs**
Here are some of the **Dell PowerEdge** and **DSS** models that support the **A40 GPU**:

#### **1. Dell PowerEdge Servers (NVIDIA-Certified)**
   - **PowerEdge XE8545**
     - **4x or 8x A40 GPUs** (NVLink Bridge support)
     - **AMD EPYC** processors (Milan or Genoa)
     - Designed for **AI, HPC, and deep learning**
     - Supports **NVIDIA AI Enterprise** software stack
   - **PowerEdge XE9680**
     - **Up to 8x A40 GPUs**
     - **4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable** or **AMD EPYC** processors
     - Optimized for **AI training & inference**
   - **PowerEdge R760 / R760xa**
     - **Up to 4x A40 GPUs** (with NVLink)
     - **4th Gen Intel Xeon Scalable** processors
     - Good for **AI, ML, and virtualization**
   - **PowerEdge R7525 / R750xa**
     - **Up to 4x A40 GPUs** (AMD EPYC-based)
     - Supports **PCIe Gen4** for high bandwidth

#### **2. Dell DSS (Data Science Servers)**
   - **DSS 8440** (Discontinued, but may still be available in some regions)
     - **Up to 4x A40 GPUs**
     - Optimized for **deep learning & AI workloads**
   - **DSS 9000** (Modular, liquid-cooled)
     - Can be configured with **A40 GPUs** in a **multi-node** setup

### **Key Features of NVIDIA A40 in Dell Servers**
✔ **7th Gen NVIDIA Ampere Architecture** (GA102 GPU)
✔ **48GB GDDR6 HBM2e Memory** (with error correction)
✔ **PCIe 4.0 x16** (for high-speed data transfer)
✔ **NVLink** (for multi-GPU scaling)
✔ **FP64, FP32, TF32, BF16, INT8, INT4** support
✔ **Virtualization (vGPU) support** for NVIDIA vComputeServer
✔ **NVIDIA AI Enterprise & CUDA/Optimized Frameworks** (TensorRT, Megatron-LM, etc.)

### **Where to Buy?**
- **Dell Official Website**: [www.dell.com](https://www.dell.com)
  - Check **PowerEdge XE series** or **custom configurations**
- **Authorized Resellers** (e.g., CDW, SHI, Insight)
- **Dell APEX** (Hybrid Cloud Solutions)
- **NVIDIA-Certified Systems Partner Page**: [NVIDIA Certified Systems](https://www.nvidia.com/en-us/data-center/resources/nvidia-certified-servers/)

### **Alternatives in Dell’s Lineup**
If the **A40** is not available, Dell also offers servers with:
- **NVIDIA A100 (PCIe & SXM)** – For extreme AI/ML workloads
- **NVIDIA A30** – More cost-effective for inference
- **NVIDIA H100 (Hopper)** – Latest-gen AI accelerator
- **NVIDIA L40S** – For AI video & LLMs

### **Conclusion**
Yes, **Dell sells servers with NVIDIA A40 GPUs**, primarily in the **PowerEdge XE series (XE8545, XE9680)** and some **PowerEdge R-series (R760, R7525)**. For the latest configurations, check **Dell’s official site** or contact a **Dell sales representative** for custom builds.
